description: Constraint characterization of the open substrate→deformation map u(q₀) in S = Im 𝔙(u(q₀)) (conj:binding-qbeta-complex-volume S-channel, Lean SDeformedVolumeChannel). CORRECTED (2026-07-26): the deformed complex volume's leading Im is Im 𝔙 = (√3/4)(Re²u−Im²u) (a₂ = i√3/4 from the A-polynomial cusp modulus τ=−i√3; proved in Lean FigureEightComplexVolume), NOT the prior heuristic √3·Re·Im. Inversion target is (Re²u−Im²u) = 4S/√3 at each anchor. Under the corrected form ALL three minimal families are refuted: F1 (fixed-phase, ∝d² even), F2 (phase-crossing, Re²−Im²≈d² so S∝d² even — corrects the old S∝d³ artefact), F3 (transverse-const, Re²−c₀² even, dominated by −c₀² ⇒ same sign both anchors). The surviving constraint is a diagonal crossing: (Re²u−Im²u)=S/κ is +0.0224 at muon, −0.0911 at proton, so a viable u(q₀) must cross |Re u|=|Im u| between the anchors. Measurement + pruning only — no u-map wired, no c_k proposed, no instance fabricated.
